Executive Summary & Strategic Paradigm Shift **Hark Pro** (launched in October 2026 by Brett Adcock, founder of Figure AI, with industrial design directed by former Apple design lead Abidur Chowdhury) represents an intentional repudiation of the legacy conversational AI paradigm. Hark rejects the blank chat box as an archaic command-line terminal, replacing it with an **ambient Graphical User Interface (GUI) and proactive Operating System for your life**. Its core architectural and design pillars include: 1. **Interactive Micro-Apps & Panels**: Dynamically building small, interactive single-purpose websites, widgets, and mini-dashboards from user prompts and live account signals. 2. **Autonomous Cloud Computer ("Handoff")**: Running headless multi-session browsers in the cloud, paired with an optional live execution viewing window where users can watch the agent browse, click, type, and complete digital chores. 3. **Proactivity Tags & Verb-Based Action Buttons**: Eliminating passive notifications and generic CRUD labels ("Submit", "Run", "Dismiss") in favor of natural-language observation tags paired with explicit active verbs (`[ Draft ]`, `[ Book ]`, `[ Pay ]`, `[ RSVP ]`, `[ Cancel ]`, `[ Reschedule ]`). 4. **Human-in-the-Loop Approvals**: Frictionless, inline decision cards that pause high-stakes actions (payments, outbound messages, bookings) for single-tap user authorization. 5. **Calm, Apple-Caliber Tactile Aesthetic**: Deep obsidian and warm ivory tones, continuous squircle geometry, refined vector iconography, and the complete absence of cartoon mascots, neon gradients, or generic AI confetti. 6. **Encrypted Credential Vault ("Secured by Hark")**: Enterprise-grade credential management isolating sensitive third-party passwords, cookies, and API keys. ### Vigil's Strategic Adaptation Path Rather than requiring self-hosters to spin up a resource-draining, crash-prone local VM farm of headless Chromium browsers and long-running Docker web servers, Vigil can achieve **full feature parity as an open-source Hark Pro** through an adapted architecture: - **Sandbox Micro-App Showcase**: Upgrading Vigil's Docker sandbox and frontend artifact pipeline to build, bundle, and showcase interactive client-side SPAs and static web apps in secure, responsive sandboxed iframes (`sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms"`), pinnable directly onto the dashboard as live home screen Panels. - **Third-Party Online Browser API (Firecrawl / Browserbase)**: Replacing local browser VM overhead with an API-driven cloud browser service using `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` (for structured extraction, markdown conversion, and DOM action sequences) and optional Browserbase live debugger URLs (for live visual execution windows). - **Sub-250ms Voice STT via Groq Whisper**: Wiring frontend `MediaRecorder` audio capture to Groq's `whisper-large-v3-turbo` API via a new dedicated backend voice endpoint, populating the input draft seamlessly. -
